v3full_config:
exp_name: v3-full
data: {source: real, seed: 42, movie_list: data/processed/eval_test.txt}
model:
  model: qwen3.7-plus
  temperature: 0.7
  max_frames: 12
  script_token_budget: 4000
  dialogue_token_budget: 3000
annotation:
  n_runs: 3
  modalities: [video, script, dialogue]
  few_shot_examples: 2
  workers: 8
protocol: {temporal_split_year: 2015, relevance_threshold: 0.5, top_k: 10}
mock: false
